description: Comparison of our force measurement convention vs Sahay et al. (arXiv:2209.12903)

our_convention.excitation: Ry hologron or boundary-primary at anchor site

scale_ratio.explanation: NOT a unit conversion. Sahay measures interaction energy in MERA bulk with renormalization amplification by isometry tensors. We measure boundary correlator changes. The ~500x factor is physical, not an error.

xi_comparison.note: Our xi from only 2 data points (dr=1,2) with 3-layer causal cone limit. Not directly comparable until we have 5+ points from 5-layer circuit.

to_match_sahay: Apply MERA unitary U to map boundary -> bulk states
Compute reduced density matrices at each MERA layer
Compute energy difference F = E_two - E_0 - 2*E_single
This requires full MERA circuit application, not just ground state energy
conclusion: For testing holographic force decay, the SHAPE (xi) matters, not absolute scale. Both conventions should give the same xi. Our priority is getting 5+ data points from a 5-layer circuit to enable proper fitting.
